items.q: Adenosine terminates most regular narrow complex SVT by transiently blocking which structure?
items.exp: A1 receptor agonism hyperpolarises AV nodal tissue interrupting AV node dependent re entry circuits (AVNRT, AVRT) within seconds, while revealing flutter waves when atrial activity continues.
r: Incorrect. Sinus effects are transient and not the therapeutic target.
Correct. AV nodal blockade breaks the circuit.
Incorrect. Block lasts seconds, never permanent.
Incorrect. It acts nodally, not on pathway muscle directly.
items.kp: Adenosine equals six second AV node freeze.

items.q: Flecainide is absolutely avoided after myocardial infarction because CAST showed what?
o: Increased mortality from proarrhythmia in scarred hearts
items.exp: CAST proved suppressing ventricular ectopy with class Ic agents after infarction increased arrhythmic death, barring flecainide and kin from structural and ischaemic hearts permanently.
r: Incorrect. It controls atrial fibrillation effectively in normal hearts.
Correct. Proarrhythmic death in scarred substrate.
Incorrect. Hepatic catastrophe was not the trial signal.
Incorrect. Block occurs but mortality mechanism is ventricular proarrhythmia.
items.kp: Scarred heart plus flecainide equals CAST lesson.

items.q: Chronic amiodarone surveillance must include which organ panel?
o: Thyroid, lung, liver and eyes (with ECG)
items.exp: Iodine rich amiodarone accumulates causing hypo or hyperthyroidism, pulmonary fibrosis, hepatitis, corneal deposits and photosensitivity, so scheduled thyroid, liver, lung and eye review accompanies therapy.
r: Incorrect. Renal checks matter but miss its signature organs.
Correct. Thyroid, lung, liver and eye monitoring.
Incorrect. Marrow suppression is not its profile.
Incorrect. Pancreatitis is not the surveillance target.
items.kp: Amiodarone follow up spells thyroid, lung, liver, eye.

items.q: Torsades de pointes with prolonged QT is treated first with which intravenous agent (plus stopping culprit)?
items.exp: Magnesium suppresses early afterdepolarisations even with normal levels, alongside culprit withdrawal, potassium repletion to high normal and overdrive pacing or isoprenaline if recurrent.
r: Incorrect. Sodium blockers worsen repolarisation chaos.
Correct. Magnesium first for torsades.
Incorrect. Calcium blockade does not shorten QT torsades.
Incorrect. Adding the QT culprit class deepens the storm.
items.kp: Twisting points: magnesium, potassium, pace faster.

items.q: Irregular wide complex tachycardia in Wolff Parkinson White atrial fibrillation must NOT receive which drug type?
o: AV nodal blockers such as verapamil or adenosine
items.exp: Blocking the AV node diverts atrial fibrillation impulses down the accessory pathway risking ventricular fibrillation, so nodal blockers are forbidden and procainamide or cardioversion leads.
r: Incorrect. Procainamide slows pathway conduction safely.
Correct. Nodal blockade can kill in WPW fibrillation.
Incorrect. Instability always earns cardioversion.
Incorrect. Specialist pathway acting agents are acceptable.
items.kp: WPW with atrial fibrillation: never block the node.

items.q: Digoxin toxicity is precipitated most classically by which electrolyte plus organ pairing?
items.exp: Low potassium increases digoxin binding to cardiac ATPase while failing kidneys reduce clearance, together provoking arrhythmias, nausea and visual changes reversed in severe cases by digoxin antibody fragments.
r: Incorrect. Hyperkalaemia marks toxicity severity, not the precipitant pair.
Correct. Low potassium plus poor clearance intoxicates.
Incorrect. Calcium worsens effects but is not the classic pair.
Incorrect. Sodium disturbance is not the digoxin trigger.
items.kp: Digoxin danger equals low potassium and failing kidneys.

items.q: Sotalol's torsades risk mandates monitoring of which two parameters chiefly?
o: QT interval and kidney function (dose clearance)
items.exp: Sotalol prolongs QT by potassium blockade and clears renally, so baseline and follow up ECG QT with creatinine guide initiation, often in hospital for high risk starts.
r: Incorrect. Hepatic and marrow checks are not its gates.
Correct. QT plus kidney function govern sotalol.
Incorrect. That pairing belongs to amiodarone surveillance.
Incorrect. Metabolic panels miss electrical risk.
items.kp: Sotalol safety lives on the ECG and creatinine.

items.q: Pill in the pocket flecainide for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation is restricted to patients with what cardiac status?
items.exp: Self administered flecainide (with AV nodal blocker cover) suits selected patients with normal ventricles and no conduction disease, after in hospital observed success, because structural disease invites proarrhythmia.
r: Incorrect. Scarred ventricles forbid class Ic drugs.
Correct. Only structurally normal hearts qualify.
Incorrect. Severe stenosis counts as structural disease.
Incorrect. Failing ventricles also bar flecainide.
items.kp: Pocket flecainide needs a normal heart certificate.

items.q: Beta blockers control atrial fibrillation rate mainly by slowing conduction where?
items.exp: Beta blockade lengthens AV nodal refractoriness, filtering atrial impulses reaching ventricles, while anticoagulation decisions follow stroke risk scores independently of rate success.
r: Incorrect. Pathway conduction needs procainamide class drugs.
Correct. AV nodal filtering controls ventricular rate.
Incorrect. Atrial circuits continue fibrillating untreated.
Incorrect. Sinus node is irrelevant once fibrillation drives atria.
items.kp: Rate control means guarding the AV node gate.

items.q: Dronedarone must be avoided in which atrial fibrillation populations after harm trials?
o: Permanent atrial fibrillation and decompensated heart failure
items.exp: Trials showed dronedarone increased cardiovascular events in permanent atrial fibrillation and mortality in severe heart failure, restricting it to non permanent fibrillation without advanced failure.
r: Incorrect. Selected paroxysmal patients may receive it cautiously.
Correct. Permanent fibrillation and bad failure forbid it.
Incorrect. Youth alone is not the contraindication.
Incorrect. Ablation adjunct use is not the barred population.
items.kp: Dronedarone: never permanent, never failing hearts.
